scope: Consistency-aware shot prompts and deterministic per-shot quality decisions
implementation: Canonical locked product, character and scene attributes are injected into every bounded prompt.
Shots after the first explicitly preserve subject geometry, appearance, lighting and screen direction from the prior shot.
Deterministic probes check vertical frame shape, duration tolerance, motion, black/frozen frames and reference similarity.
Quality decisions are explainable and limited to accept, retry_shot or degrade; severe reference drift fails closed to degradation.
residual_risks: Probe production and automatic local-redo workflow wiring remain part of later orchestration and UX milestones.
Caption safe zones, audio mix, final timing and composition quality remain CSV2-07.
A real paid full-film MP4 and Beijing production rollback acceptance remain mandatory CSV2-10 terminal evidence.
